title: Automation Screen Cut off
body:
I have noticed a small problem in the automation. The right screen is cut off (see screenshot). Latest version AAPS 2.8.2, occurred on a Samsung Galaxy A40 after an update to Android 11 UI version 3.1. Maybe you can take a look at this and optimise it. Otherwise, I am very satisfied with AAPS, respect to all those who have contributed here.
Best regards Thomas
